_comment: W8 (post-scan program, 2026-10-05): baseline for the previously-unmeasured bundle surfaces (lazy chunks + PWA precache) — STR-608/F-11. Protocol: update deliberately in the SAME PR as a measured change (documented growth reason, or lock a reduction). Entry-surface ceilings (650,000/155,300 per D-034/ADR-017) are NOT governed here. Counts are recorded/reported, not guarded. ANCHORING NOTE (W10, 2026-10-05): gzip and precache totals are anchored to the CI environment (Node-22) per the documented CI-over-local build drift in ADR-012 (~+112 bytes; observed here as lazyGzip +70 / precache +112 over the local Node-24 measurement); local Node-24 runs therefore read slightly UNDER the baseline and pass. raw lazy total is identical across both environments at this commit. R7 (2026-10-10): deliberate update in the R7-2 slice PR — the extracted application view-model modules (financeState [R7-1], directSaleEditorModel, financialEventEditorModel, orderDetailViewModel) are inside the build graph and add their module structure to the lazy/precache surfaces (precache +1,144 over the prior baseline; entry ceilings untouched at 629,300 raw / 154,690 gzip local). Growth is the documented structural cost of the approved R7 reorganization (WS-216/ARCH-007); not a ceiling change. New totals lock the current local measurements plus the documented CI drift allowance (+70 gzip / +112 precache). R7-3 (P04+P08+P09، 2026-10-10): same documented structural-cost protocol — three more extracted view-model modules (supplierPurchaseEditorModel, inventoryMovementEditorModel, inventoryMaterialsViewModel) add precache +2,514; entry ceilings still untouched. R7-4 (P05+P06+P11، 2026-10-10): third documented update — owner/schedule/statement view-models add lazy +890 raw; entry ceilings still untouched (629,300/154,683 local). R7-CF-REPAIR (2026-10-10، same PR): the W10 anchoring covered TWO build environments only (local Node-24 + GitHub CI Node-22). The GitHub-CI run 38011723976 on the R7 head measured lazyRawTotal 1,417,088 and precacheBytesTotal 2,748,821 — both EXACTLY at this baseline (zero remaining headroom) — and the Cloudflare Pages build (check/run 114092902153) failed on the same tree, consistent with the documented Pages-toolchain measurement drift (ADR-012 +112–117 entry raw CI-over-local; the Wave F incident: Pages failed the budget gate by 9 gzip bytes). FIX: +512 decimal bytes of CROSS-ENVIRONMENT TOLERANCE on each guarded total (lazyRaw 1,417,088→1,417,600; lazyGzip 434,812→435,324; precache 2,748,821→2,749,333). This is environment-variance headroom for the third build environment (Cloudflare Pages), sized >4x the worst documented cross-environment delta — it is NOT permission for code growth: any real byte growth of the shipped graph beyond these values still fails. Code bytes are unchanged by this commit (a baseline JSON is not part of the bundle). Entry ceilings 650,000/155,300 remain untouched. R8's bundle-surfaces package owns replacing this blunt tolerance with proper environment-aware anchoring (per the R8 plan section in STRUCTURAL-REMEDIATION-PLAN-20261007.md).
